about: T113 (rule 7): a TOOL CALL that names the tool already in the spindle and no tool axis only changes the speed, as the program map and the tool list read it (syntax-heidenhain §5.1): no tool change, the tool stays. With an axis it is a real call (the control may swap in a sister tool). A number compares as a number, a name exactly, and the indexed tool 12.1 is not tool 12.

states.about: The same tool, no axis: a speed change.
The same name, no axis: a speed change.
Tool 12 is not the indexed tool 12.1: a tool change.
